info.title: Cara Gateway API
info.summary: REST resources and a JSON-RPC WebSocket for Cara clients.
info.description: Resources such as sessions, automations, and alarms are plain REST. Commands and events of a live conversation share one JSON-RPC WebSocket connection at /v1/gateway.

200.description: The gateway application stack is ready.

put.summary: Replace an alarm's recurrence, routine, and pre-wake lead

post.summary: Skip the next occurrence of a recurring alarm
Dismiss the current occurrence of an alarm

put.summary: Replace an automation's schedule and payload

get.summary: List sessions ordered by creation time

post.summary: Open the latest session of a channel, creating one if none exists
